slides.texto_narrado: What nobody tells you about letting your kid loose with whatever's ready in the garden — he might actually out-cook you.
It started with him picking whatever looked ready. No recipe in mind, just... what's out here today.
Then he grabbed a card and started writing it down himself — spelling be damned, *his* recipe, *his* words.
We cooked it exactly the way he wrote it. No substitutions, no corrections.
And it was *good*. Not because it was perfect — because every bite was proof he'd actually been paying attention out there.
His recipe is now page one of ours. Garden-to-table family cookbook, link in bio.// Here's what nobody tells you about handing them the harvest.
